QuestInfo.name: Ereve, Island of the Empress
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Beldar about forming a relation with the Cygnus Knights.
QuestInfo.1: Find #bNeinheart#k the tactician in #bEreve#k, the island of the Empress, as Beldar said.
QuestInfo.2: You found Neinheart in Ereve, the island of the Empress.

0.0: It looks like you've decided. I'll write you a letter of introduction to the Cygnus Knights.
0.1: Take this letter of introduction and go to Maple World. Go to Ereve, the island of the Empress, and you can meet their tactician, Neinheart. \r\n#r#e* If you accept, you will move to Ereve.#n#k

yes.0: Then I will look forward to your great work.

0.msg: #b(There isn't really time for that right now. Better to come back later.)#k
Welcome to Ereve. I am Neinheart, tactician to the Empress. Do you have any business with me?

1.msg: #b(So he's gonna dig his heels in on this. I guess I should just get this over with.)#k

yes.0: Hm... Isn't this a letter of introduction from the Nova Council? Please wait a moment while I read it.

item.0: Do you have any business with me? Please tell me if you have something that needs to be delivered.
